title: git-vouch-migrate drafts --as <handle>
description: Run locally by each certifier (D10): from pgpkeys@C and the registry, write unsigned endorsement drafts for every key the certifier certified whose holder has merged a person file with a verified continuity proof and no duplicate claim. subjectEmails from the certified UIDs; note 'certified GPG key <fpr> on <date>'. Includes SHA-1 certifications (Claude's call: the certifier re-signs with SSH now, so the old hash does not matter; flag for Mark). Excludes certifications later revoked (class 0x30).
acceptance_criteria: Tests with throwaway keyrings: drafts generated only for continuity-verified subjects; revoked certifications excluded; output validates as endorsement records once signed with git vouch endorse.
notes: DECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22): include SHA-1 certifications in drafts (draft is a reminder; certifier's SSH signature counts). DESIGN.md updated; earlier 'non-SHA-1' text removed.
